name: Lane One
author: Dandyhorse
description: A treadmill and bike console, and a track to go round. Manual, hills, intervals, pyramid, random and heart-rate programmes, every number a machine's own console shows, and a lap of a real 400 m track for each one you run.

programme-done.name: Saw it through
programme-done.description: Finished a whole programme without stopping early.

the-hour.name: The hour
the-hour.description: A whole hour of exercise in one session.

zone-four.name: Up in zone four
zone-four.description: Ten minutes at zone 4 or above.

even-splits.name: Metronome
even-splits.description: Five laps in a row within five seconds of each other.

good-recovery.name: Settles fast
good-recovery.description: Heart rate fell 40 bpm in the recovery minute.

variants.name: Lane One (Treadmill)
variants.description: Walk or run a programme. The console drives the incline and shows you the pace to keep; hand it the belt as well and it runs the whole thing.

variants.name: Lane One (Bike)
variants.description: Ride a programme. The trainer follows the hill and the watts are yours to hold; hand it the watts as well and it holds them for you in ERG.

sound.description: Beep when a programme segment changes and at each lap.

bigNumbers.description: Start in the big-numbers view instead of the track.

trackLane.description: Which lane to run in. Lane 1 is 400 m; each lane out adds about 7 m a lap.
